# MoroAI

> Local-first model adaptation foundry for private small language models.
> Apache-2.0 licensed, open-source Python CLI + web dashboard.

MoroAI transforms private organizational data into dependable, specialized local language models (1.5B to 14B parameters) on consumer GPUs (e.g. RTX 3060, 4070, Apple Silicon M-series) with zero cloud lock-in.

## Core Documentation
- [Quickstart (5 min)](https://moroai.cc/docs/getting-started/quickstart/): Scaffolding, compilation, training, and evaluation
- [Introduction](https://moroai.cc/docs/getting-started/introduction/): Philosophy and architecture
- [Installation Guide](https://moroai.cc/docs/getting-started/installation/): Setup with pip and Ollama
- [Your First Model](https://moroai.cc/docs/getting-started/first-model/): End-to-end tutorial

## Architecture & Concepts
- [System Overview](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/overview/): The 5 architectural pillars
- [Epistemic Data Compiler](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/data-compiler/): Quality scoring and curation
- [PPMI & MI Guard](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/ppci-filtering/): Shannon mutual information outlier protection
- [Hardware Recipe Engine](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/recipe-engine/): Exact pre-flight VRAM memory prediction
- [Self-Healing Training Engine](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/training-engine/): 5-step topological OOM recovery
- [Multi-Layer Eval Harness](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/eval-harness/): Deterministic and semantic scoring
- [DPO Feedback Flywheel](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/flywheel/): Continuous alignment from production logs
- [Lineage & Provenance](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/lineage-graphs/): Immutable hash manifests
- [Release Governance](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/governance/): SBOM generation and release gates
- [Mission Control UI](https://moroai.cc/docs/concepts/dashboard/): Real-time training dashboard

## Cookbooks & Blueprints
- [Customer Support Bot](https://moroai.cc/docs/cookbook/support-bot/): Q&A fine-tuning on company FAQs
- [Structured JSON Extractor](https://moroai.cc/docs/cookbook/json-extractor/): Schema-strictly grounded document extraction
- [Code Assistant](https://moroai.cc/docs/cookbook/code-assistant/): Internal library and refactoring copilot
- [Document Summarizer](https://moroai.cc/docs/cookbook/document-summarizer/): Long-context FlashAttention executive briefs
- [Medical Q&A System](https://moroai.cc/docs/cookbook/medical-qa/): Clinical guideline adaptation with HIPAA compliance
- [Legal Document Analyzer](https://moroai.cc/docs/cookbook/legal-analyzer/): NDA and contract clause extraction
